Our delivery plan is structured to meet the Energy Department’s requirement to design, supply, install, test and commission 5 MW of grid-tied PV across twelve operating hospitals, secure DISCO net-metering approvals, train hospital engineering staff, and then provide three (3) years of O&M from commissioning [CO-PROFILE]. We will execute in overlapping phases with parallel installation crews, using schedule anchors consistent with our completed solar deployments (10–20 months depending on scope and stakeholders) [CAP-032] [CAP-044] [CAP-020].

Phase 0 – Mobilization & governance (Weeks 1–2): kickoff, HSE planning for live healthcare environments (our documented HSE policy and safety planning approach is standard on infrastructure deployments) [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 1 – Site surveys & data capture (Weeks 2–6): survey each hospital, collect electrical and structural data, define interconnection points and construction sequencing.

Phase 2 – Detailed engineering & approvals pack (Weeks 4–10): single-line diagrams, layout/structural design, BoQ, method statements, and net-metering application packages; DISCO liaison runs in parallel through commissioning.

Phase 3 – Procurement & logistics (Weeks 6–16): release orders for compliant Tier-1 modules/inverters and mounting; inspect and stage materials for rolling site starts.

Phase 4 – Installation (Months 4–8): civil works, mounting, DC/AC works, protections, earthing, and IEC-aligned quality checks under our ISO 9001 QMS [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 5 – Testing, commissioning & DISCO synchronization (Months 7–10): site energization, performance verification, as-builts, and net-metering approvals.

Phase 6 – Training, handover & O&M (Month 10 onward): structured staff training and a three-year O&M program with quarterly preventive maintenance and 24–48h response SLAs [CO-PROFILE].

SCADA: our library does not yet evidence a SCADA/IoT central dashboard delivery; we will address this via a specialist monitoring partner integrated into our delivery and O&M workflows [CO-PROFILE].
